title: Normalized smooth mollifier on ℝⁿ with support in a given ball
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every r > 0 there is ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure) such that ρ is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), ρ has compact support, ρ(x) ≥ 0 for all x, ∫_{ℝⁿ} ρ = 1, and support ρ ⊆ B_r(0) (the open ball of radius r about 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ρ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ HasCompactSupport ρ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧ ∫ x, ρ x = 1 ∧ support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) r
